games:2026-wk10-miami-notre-dame.blurb: The No. 1 team in the country walks into South Bend as a 7-point underdog, with ESPN's model giving Notre Dame a 60.5% edge. A total of 54.5 suggests points are available, and Miami's hold on the top spot is the thing on the line.

games:2026-wk10-georgia-ole-miss.blurb: No. 2 Georgia is a 3.5-point favorite on the road against No. 10 Ole Miss, one of the few spots all year the Bulldogs are close to a coin flip (55.5% per ESPN). A 56.5 total points to a shootout in Oxford with SEC positioning on the line.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-cincinnati-hou.blurb: No. 17 Houston hosts Cincinnati as a 10.5-point favorite with an 83.9% win probability, and the 61.5 total is the highest on the board this week. Style points matter for the Cougars' ranking.

predictions:notre-dame.blurb: Notre Dame dropped from No. 5 to No. 11 while sitting No. 1 in FPI and No. 3 in SP+. Hosting No. 1 Miami as a favorite is the quickest route back up.

games:2026-wk10-byu-utah.blurb: The Holy War arrives with real Big 12 weight: No. 3 Utah hosts No. 9 BYU as a 4-point favorite with the total sitting at a modest 49.5. The league's top two teams meet with the conference's automatic bid pointed squarely at the winner.

games:2026-wk10-alabama-lsu.blurb: No. 5 Alabama heads to Baton Rouge as a 6-point underdog to No. 14 LSU, with ESPN's model giving the Tigers a 56.9% edge in this one. A rivalry night with a 53.5 total, and the loser's SEC race math gets a lot harder.

games:2026-wk10-kentucky-tennessee.blurb: No. 6 Kentucky is the higher-ranked team but a 6-point road dog at No. 13 Tennessee, where ESPN gives the Vols a 66.7% shot. Tennessee needs this to climb out of the bubble; Kentucky needs it to protect a top-10 spot.

games:2026-wk10-oregon-ohio-state.blurb: No. 12 Ohio State lays 7.5 at home against No. 23 Oregon with a tight 44.5 total, and ESPN pegs the Buckeyes at 83.2%. Ohio State is trying to steady itself after a tumble in the rankings; Oregon would love to be the team that finishes the slide.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-texas-missouri.blurb: No. 7 Texas visits No. 18 Missouri as a 2.5-point favorite, the kind of line that says this is a coin flip in Columbia. The 44.5 total suggests both defenses show up.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-ucla-minnesota.blurb: No. 8 UCLA goes to Minnesota favored by just 3.5 with a 38.5 total, pointing to a grinder. The Bruins are chasing Indiana in the Big Ten and can't afford a slip here.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-west-virginia-.blurb: No. 15 Texas Tech is a 16.5-point home favorite over West Virginia with a 66.5 total, and ESPN gives the Red Raiders an 89.4% chance. Sitting on the back edge of the bubble, Tech needs the style points as much as the win.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-oklahoma-flori.blurb: No. 24 Florida hosts Oklahoma as a 4.5-point favorite, with ESPN's model liking the Gators at 64.2%. A win keeps Florida in the rankings conversation; a loss likely ends it.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-iowa-northwest.blurb: No. 19 Iowa is a 3-point favorite at Northwestern, though ESPN actually leans Wildcats at 55.2% — a rare split between the line and the model. The 42.5 total fits the matchup.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-boise-state-co.blurb: No. 25 Boise State is a 16.5-point favorite at Colorado State with the total up at 68.5, and ESPN gives the Broncos a 93.3% shot. Business trip for a team trying to hold its place at the back of the Top 25.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-tcu-arizona.blurb: Arizona pulled off a wild 29-28 finish, scoring on a Noah Fifita 15-yard touchdown pass to Quincy Craig with 1:45 left, failing the two-pointer, then recovering an onside pooch kick to set up Michael Salgado-Medina's 37-yard field goal with 39 seconds to go. TCU had led 28-20 in the fourth behind Jaden Craig's second rushing score, and Hudson Hooper's 93-yard pick-six in the second quarter looked like the game's defining play until Tyrese Boss sealed it with a late interception.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-merrimack-wake.blurb: No. 16 Wake Forest is favored by 46.5 over Merrimack, a get-right afternoon for a team that slipped two spots in the rankings. The only question is how long the starters stay on the field.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-texas-a-m-sout.blurb: No. 21 South Carolina hosts Texas A&M as a 6.5-point favorite, with ESPN giving the Gamecocks a narrower 54.1% edge. A 52.5 total hints at points in Columbia.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: A brutal fall from No. 2 to No. 12 for Ohio State, but the computers haven't blinked — SP+ still has the Buckeyes first and FPI second. That gap between poll perception and model math makes them the most dangerous team outside the top 10.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky climbed from No. 9 to No. 6, but the models are deeply skeptical: 31st in SP+ and 26th in FPI. A trip to Tennessee will tell us which number is closer to the truth.

predictions:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest slid from No. 14 to No. 16 despite an FPI that likes them at 11th. SP+ is the dissenter at 25th, leaving the Demon Deacons a bit of a split decision.

predictions:utah.blurb: Utah jumped from No. 6 to No. 3 while both models hold steady at 10th. The Holy War is the Utes' chance to prove the poll, not the computers, has it right.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: Georgia at No. 2 holds the SEC's auto bid, with Alabama three spots back at No. 5 — close enough that one Saturday flips it. The Tide's trip to LSU is the next domino.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: Indiana sits at No. 4 atop the Big Ten with UCLA four spots behind at No. 8. The Bruins control their own climb, but they have to keep winning to stay in range.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: Utah's No. 3 ranking gives it a six-spot cushion over No. 9 BYU in the Big 12 race — and the two meet head-to-head this week. The gap can close in a hurry.

bubbleNotes:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State tumbled 10 spots to the 13 seed, now one place outside the field. No. 23 Oregon comes to Columbus next, a chance to stop the bleeding immediately.

bubbleNotes:lsu.blurb: LSU nudged up a spot to the 15 seed but still sits three places out of the field. Hosting No. 5 Alabama is exactly the kind of result that would fix that.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech slipped two spots to the 16 seed, four places from the field and running out of runway. The Red Raiders need wins and help.

bubbleNotes:tennessee.blurb: Tennessee is trending the right way, up three to the 14 seed and two spots from the field. No. 6 Kentucky visits next with a chance to push the Vols all the way in.
